gloss.l.shortlong: a or aa, ui or ei
gloss.s.shortlong.1: The man looks at the moon.
gloss.s.shortlong.2: Put the onions in the bag.
gloss.s.shortlong.3: The shop opens at nine o'clock.
gloss.c.shortlong.a: No, thank you. I have already eaten.
gloss.c.shortlong.a.why: An egg is offered: a polite no, with a reason.
gloss.c.roundsounds.a.why: Asked if the door is open: this reply says it is not.
gloss.l.pbgk: p or b, g or k
gloss.s.pbgk.1: Throw the rubbish in the bin.
gloss.s.pbgk.2: It is cold in the hall.
gloss.c.pbgk.a.why: Asked how you are: an answer, and how you feel.
gloss.k.uitleg.a: Open your mouth, a little less than for aa. Your tongue goes back. Say it short.
gloss.k.uitleg.aa: Open your mouth wide. Your lips are relaxed. Your tongue lies low and flat.
gloss.k.uitleg.e: Your mouth is half open, more than for ee. Your lips are relaxed. Say it short.
gloss.k.uitleg.ee: Your mouth is half open. Your lips are wide, as in a smile. The tip of your tongue touches your lower teeth.
gloss.k.uitleg.i: As for ie, but your mouth is a little more open and relaxed. Say it short.
gloss.k.uitleg.ie: Your mouth is almost closed. Your lips are wide, as in a smile. Your tongue is high and forward.
gloss.k.uitleg.o: Your mouth is open. Your lips are a little round. Your tongue is at the back. Say it short.
gloss.k.uitleg.oo: Your lips are round. Your mouth is half open. At the end your lips get smaller.
gloss.k.uitleg.u: Your lips are a little round, not tight. Your tongue is forward. Say it short.
gloss.k.uitleg.uu: Lips round and tight, as for a kiss. Your tongue forward, as for ie.
gloss.k.uitleg.oe: Make your lips round and tight, pushed far forward. There is only a small hole. Your tongue stays at the back of your mouth.
gloss.k.uitleg.eu: Your mouth is half open. Your lips are round, but not tight. Your tongue forward, as for ee.
gloss.k.uitleg.ui: Start with your mouth half open and round lips. Then make your lips small, to uu. Your lips stay round.
gloss.k.uitleg.ij: Start with your mouth half open and wide lips. Then almost close your mouth, to ie.
gloss.k.uitleg.ou: Start with your mouth open. Then make your lips small and round, to oe.
